cards.card_text: David had already told him, "Your blood be on your own head because your own mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I killed the LORD’s anointed.’"
cards.verse_text: Then David summoned one of the young men and said, “Go, execute him!” So the young man struck him down, and he died. For David had said to the Amalekite, “Your blood be on your own head because your own mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I killed the LORD’s anointed.’”
